## Problem

Given an array containing an even number of values, divide its elements into pairs. For each pair, take its smaller value and add these minima together. Arrange the pairings so that this total is as large as possible, then return that maximum sum.

### Example
Input: 2 7 5 9

Output: 9

Pairing `2` with `5` and `7` with `9` produces minima of `2` and `7`, so the resulting total is `9`.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

To maximize the sum of minima, you want to pair large numbers together so their minimum is still large.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Sort the array first, then pair adjacent elements (0 with 1, 2 with 3, etc.) to get the largest possible minima.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

The answer is simply the sum of every other element starting from index 0 after sorting.

</details>
